svg.title: Building in private
svg.desc: Orbit, AI second brain · SwiftUI app + Go, Postgres 18, React 19 platform: 12 Swift modules · GRDB · CloudKit; on-device speech · watch · widgets; bring your own model: 6 providers; deep research with cited sources; 71 tables, RLS on every user table; OpenAPI 3.1 contract: 194 ops; pgvector + full-text search; built by a Claude Code agent fleet. AUREX voice agent, macOS · Swift · Claude: speech streams while Claude writes; cursor grounded in AX tree; direct API path · p50/p90 log; 61-row parity study · RE report. Daily research agent, Claude scheduled tasks: AI, systems, security, twice a day; deep design docs with real code; remembers coverage, no repeats; locked-down tools · offline tests. CodeChakra, PR review agent · FastAPI: flags latency, security, logic; explains every suggested fix; per-PR latency analytics; GitHub-triggered PR reviews. Grievance AI agent, FastAPI · Streamlit · RAG: chat intake in natural language; Groq LLM + sentence embeddings; admin panel · live analytics; role-based access. Schema graph builder, NL2SQL grounding · Python: parses tables, keys and joins; spaCy + Sentence-BERT links; NetworkX + PyVis graph; grounds LLM-written SQL. Android malware ML, APK analysis · TensorFlow: 30K decompiled apps; permissions · opcodes · API calls; Androguard · apktool pipeline; Flask app gives a verdict. Vig-WaR, ransomware defense · IEEE 2024: 99.3% detection quality; 530 ms to detect, 98 ms to stop; GMM · affinity propagation · PCA; M.Tech thesis, first author.
